Attached: 1 image

It has been a productive day! You know, following up on the journal idea from yesterday: I *really* have grown to adore having a pomodoro that tracks how much time I spend on focusing and taking a break each day.

I may have brought this up before, but I have a hard time legitimizing my free time and doing things for myself, so when I have an app showing me I've worked at almost a 3:1 ratio today, it is a lot easier to put the brakes on near the end of the day.

#OpenSource #Productivity #psychology
